layout_note: Use the real ASE 2025 HFDecomposer artifact through dataset_candidate/hfdecomposer/. It contains 153 real-world header decompositions, ground-truth summaries, author source_code, and an openssl example project.
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. For scripts that write outputs, copy source_code/ or selected header instances into project/ and run from that writable copy.

python_environment.note: The virtual environment is prepared automatically at container startup with networkx/tree-sitter/sklearn and related deps; do not recreate a host .venv inside the shared mount.

not_provided.full_project_checkouts: Only header instances + one openssl example project are packaged; clone additional repos only if your method needs full build graphs and document that step.
not_provided.author_api_keys: GPT-4o / DeepSeek credentials are not included; use the benchmark LLM proxy or your own keys.
